payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 13:3–10 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states abijah describes the Davidic kingdom as the kingdom of the LORD while confronting Jeroboam’s larger army and calves. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
